technical_and_design_decisions: Implement all work in the Go configtx package, following the existing package conventions: modification functions that accept/return *cb.ConfigGroup or config types, functional Options structs where applicable, and protobuf marshal/unmarshal helpers already present in the codebase.

U1: Add a GetChannelConfig function that composes the existing dependent-field retrieval functions (application, orderer, consortiums, policies, capabilities, etc.) and returns a fully populated config.Channel.

U2: Implement the channel creation policy update as a ConfigValue (not ConfigPolicy) mutation on the target consortium group, e.g. UpdateConsortiumChannelCreationPolicy(config, consortiumName, policy), mirroring how other consortium ConfigValues are handled.

U3: Add channel-group-level policy functions AddChannelPolicy, RemoveChannelPolicy, and GetChannelPolicies that operate on the root channel ConfigGroup, reusing the existing policy conversion/marshaling helpers used for other groups.

U4/U5: Implement removal functions (RemoveConsortiumOrg, RemoveApplicationOrg, RemoveOrdererOrg, RemoveConsortium) by deleting the named child group from the parent ConfigGroup's Groups map, with explicit error handling when the target does not exist.

U6: Split system channel creation into a separate API function (e.g. NewSystemChannelGenesisBlock) rather than overloading application channel creation; it builds a channel group containing only orderer and consortiums groups (no application group) and produces a genesis block via the standard block-creation helper.

U8: Extend SigningIdentity with a SignConfigUpdate method; introduce the renamed SignConfigUpdateEnvelope as a SigningIdentity method and keep the old CreateSignedConfigUpdateEnvelope as a thin deprecated wrapper for backward compatibility.

Testing uses the repository's existing test style (standard Go tests with testify/require) and runnable example_test.go examples; all new public functions get unit tests plus examples where the stories require them.
assumptions: The supporting retrieval functions for all dependent configuration fields mentioned in U1 already exist and are tested, so U1 is composition work rather than building those from scratch.

The development environment (Go toolchain, vendored dependencies, Fabric protobuf types) is set up and the developer is proficient in Go, protobuf, and Hyperledger Fabric channel configuration concepts.

One workday equals 8 hours of focused development effort by a single developer (the author), including writing unit tests and examples; code review is performed as self-review with allocated rework time.

Effort covers design, implementation, unit tests, runnable examples, and GoDoc documentation only; it excludes release management, CI pipeline changes, downstream integration into Fabric core, and any translation/localization work.
Public API naming and signatures are free to be chosen by the implementer as long as acceptance criteria are met, and no external stakeholder approval cycles are required.
Existing CI/build infrastructure will run the new tests without modification.

activities.activity_description: Analyze U1-U8, study the existing configtx package structure and helpers, and define the public API surface: function names and signatures, the separate system-channel genesis function decision (U6), the SigningIdentity extension and rename strategy (U8), and shared error-handling conventions.

Implement GetChannelConfig that composes the existing dependent-field retrieval functions into a full config.Channel return value; add unit tests covering populated and minimally populated channel configurations.

activities.activity_name: U2: Update consortium channel creation policy value
activities.activity_description: Implement the function to update the default channel creation policy ConfigValue within a consortium group on config updates; add unit tests and a runnable example in example_test.go.
Implement add, remove, and retrieve functions for policies on the root channel group, reusing existing policy helpers; add unit tests and update examples to demonstrate usage.

activities.activity_name: U4: Remove consortium, application, and orderer organizations
activities.activity_description: Implement three separate functions for removing an organization from a consortium group, the application group, and the orderer group, including not-found error handling; add unit tests and update examples.

activities.activity_name: U5: Remove consortium from channel config
activities.activity_description: Implement a function to remove a specific consortium from the consortiums group of a channel config; add unit tests and update examples.

activities.activity_name: U6: System channel genesis block creation
activities.activity_description: Implement a function to create a system channel genesis block whose channel group contains only orderer and consortiums groups (no application group); add unit tests validating block structure and a new runnable example.

activities.activity_name: U7: GoDocs Overview section for configtx package
activities.activity_description: Author the package-level doc.go Overview section explaining the purpose and usage of the configtx library and how channels are structured, and verify rendering in GoDoc.

activities.activity_name: U8: SigningIdentity extension and signing API rename
activities.activity_description: Extend SigningIdentity with SignConfigUpdate, add the renamed SignConfigUpdateEnvelope method, retain CreateSignedConfigUpdateEnvelope as a deprecated wrapper, write GoDoc explaining usage and differences, and add/adjust unit tests.

Run the full package test suite and examples, perform cross-feature integration testing (e.g., build config, update it, sign it, retrieve it end-to-end), verify no regressions in existing API behavior, and fix defects found.
Perform self-review of all changes for consistency, style, and documentation completeness; refactor and rework as needed; finalize comments, examples, and package docs for merge readiness.
